title: Dealer addition (BOW front end, DEALER ID_ADDITION_UPLOAD)
purpose: Creates dealer logins in BOW (upload menu DEALERS / EMPLOYEE; dealers log in through the thick client only). One line per active dealer in Ledgerline's dealer register that is new or changed since the last file. 13 fields; passwords never written. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Dealer Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The dealer's BOW dealer ID (Connections → BOW upload files, or the Ledgerline dealer ID without the hyphen; 10 characters at most)

columns.name: Owner Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The admin ID (e.g. T1001) or mini admin ID (miniadmin-T1001) the user is created under: Owner Id in Connections → BOW upload files

columns.name: Dealer Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Repeats the dealer ID (as in BOW's samples)

columns.name: User Type
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 2 for a dealer

columns.name: Password
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BOW wants an initial password (8 characters or more with a letter, a digit and a special character). Ledgerline NEVER writes passwords: the field is left empty; set it in BOW (or in the file just before uploading)

columns.name: First Name
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The first word of the dealer's name

columns.name: Last Name
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The rest of the name (the first name again when the name is one word)

columns.name: Email Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. E-mail from the dealer register

columns.name: Default Marketwatch
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Always N

columns.name: Mobile No
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Mobile number

columns.name: Pan Card No
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. PAN

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (dealer addition)
